notes: NEW PRODUCT ONLY: Apex states that products bought after March 1, 2026 use the new Intraday/EOD structure; earlier recurring products are Legacy and are not represented here.
ONE-TIME EVALUATION: the new product card says 'ONE-TIME Fee. No Rebill. Eval Active for 30 Days' and says there are no resets.

PARTIAL PRICE CAPTURE: only the 25K Intraday Standard list fee ($199) and current activation fee ($59) were exposed by the first-party product card. The $19.90 coupon price was tied to an affiliate-code URL and is disclosed but not used in True-Cost math. Prices for 50K, 100K and 150K remain null.
ACTIVATION-FEE CONFLICT: current first-party crawl variants showed $59 on the 25K card; older first-party variants showed $69. The current $59 value is recorded and must be rechecked before purchase.
PROFIT TARGETS are $1,500 / $3,000 / $6,000 / $9,000 on $25K / $50K / $100K / $150K. Each equals 6% of the headline balance.
INTRADAY TRAILING DRAWDOWN follows the highest balance in real time, includes unrealized gains, and never moves down. Dollar caps are $1,000 / $2,000 / $3,000 / $4,000.
NO EVALUATION DAILY LOSS LIMIT applies on Intraday products; the real-time trailing threshold is the evaluation risk control.
ONE-DAY PASS: there is no minimum beyond one trading day, but the evaluation expires after 30 calendar days. A passed evaluation must be activated within 7 calendar days.

NO EVALUATION CONSISTENCY RULE applies. The Performance Account uses a 50% payout-consistency requirement: the largest profitable day must be below 50% of total profit since inception or the last approved payout.

PAYOUT ELIGIBILITY requires 5 qualifying trading days, a $500 minimum request, the drawdown-plus-$100 safety net, and the 50% consistency rule. Each Performance Account closes after its 6th approved payout.
100% PAYOUT SPLIT applies to approved Sim Funded Performance Account payouts.
INTRADAY PAYOUT-DAY MINIMUMS are $100 / $200 / $250 / $300 for $25K / $50K / $100K / $150K. The first-request caps are $1,000 / $1,500 / $2,000 / $2,500.
DAY TRADING ONLY: positions must be flat before 4:59 PM ET; trading may resume at 6:00 PM ET. This excludes overnight and weekend holding.
NEWS TRADING is restricted, not banned: normal-strategy trading is allowed, while news chasing, hedging and two-sided gambling orders are prohibited.
AUTOMATION is banned. Copying is restricted to the same user's accounts when the originating order is entered manually in real time and the receiving accounts mirror it exactly.
INACTIVITY: each new Performance Account needs at least 2 trading days with $50 or more net profit inside every rolling 30-day window; otherwise the PA can close permanently.
Performance Accounts are simulated. Apex may invite selected traders into a separate live program.
The published account path supports Rithmic, Tradovate and WealthCharts; certain EUREX products are available only through Tradovate.

EOD STANDARD uses the same post-March 1, 2026 one-time 30-day evaluation model, but current evaluation and activation prices remain null because the selected product cards could not be independently exposed.
EOD DRAWDOWN is calculated from the end-of-day balance at market close and then enforced intraday during the following session. Dollar caps are $1,000 / $2,000 / $3,000 / $4,000.
EVALUATION DAILY LOSS LIMITS are $500 / $1,000 / $1,500 / $2,000. Reaching the DLL flattens positions and pauses trading for the session but does not fail the evaluation.
ONE-DAY PASS, 30-calendar-day evaluation access and 7-day activation deadline match the Intraday path.
NO EVALUATION CONSISTENCY RULE applies; the funded payout gate is the separate 50% consistency requirement.
PAYOUT ELIGIBILITY requires 5 qualifying trading days, a $500 minimum request, the drawdown-plus-$100 safety net, and no single day at or above 50% of total profit.
EOD QUALIFYING-DAY MINIMUMS are $100 / $250 / $300 / $350 for $25K / $50K / $100K / $150K.
EOD FIRST-REQUEST CAPS are $1,000 / $1,500 / $2,000 / $2,500. Each PA closes after 6 approved payouts.
The 100% payout split, day-trading cutoff, restricted news rule, automation ban, same-user copy restriction and inactivity rule match the Intraday path.
EOD Performance Accounts use tier-based contract and daily-loss scaling; the starting maximum contract counts are 2 / 4 / 6 / 10 across $25K / $50K / $100K / $150K.
